calorie-bmi.title: Calorie & BMI Calculator
calorie-bmi.description: Estimate your Body Mass Index and daily calorie needs.
calorie-bmi.bmi_description: Body Mass Index — weight relative to height, used as a rough indicator of body fatness.
calorie-bmi.bmr_description: Basal Metabolic Rate — calories your body burns at rest just to sustain basic functions. Calculated using the Mifflin-St Jeor equation from your weight, height, age, and sex.
calorie-bmi.tdee_description: Total Daily Energy Expenditure — estimated calories to maintain your current weight. Calculated by multiplying your BMR by an activity-level factor.
calorie-bmi.protein_description: Builds and repairs muscle. Calculated from your bodyweight and activity level (1.2-2.0 g/kg/day), scaled down slightly for women to reflect a typically higher body-fat percentage relative to lean mass.
calorie-bmi.fat_description: Supports hormones and nutrient absorption. Takes a share of the calories left after protein, based on general dietary guidelines (around 20-35% of total calories).
calorie-bmi.carbs_description: Your body's main energy source. Takes the remaining calories left after protein and fat, based on general dietary guidelines (around 45-65% of total calories).

investment.title: Investment Calculator
investment.description: Project how a one-time investment, a monthly savings plan, or both grow over time — after fees, taxes, and inflation.
investment.net_payout_description: What actually lands in your account at the end — portfolio value minus the sell fee and capital gains tax.
investment.total_contributed_description: Everything you paid in over the whole period: the one-time investment plus every monthly rate, fees included.
investment.net_gain_description: Final value minus what you invested, and the same figure as a percentage of your contributions (ROI).
investment.effective_return_description: Your actual money-weighted return per year (IRR). It sits below the expected return because fees and taxes cost you, and because later contributions had less time to grow.
investment.total_fees_description: Buy fees charged on every purchase plus the one-off sell fee at the end. This money is never invested, so it also costs you all the growth it would have earned.
investment.sell_fee_amount_description: The one-off fee charged when the position is sold at the end. Buy fees are not listed here — they were already taken off as the money went in, so they are baked into the portfolio value.
investment.tax_description: Capital gains tax on the profit at sale, after the sell fee has been deducted. Applied once, on the assumption you sell everything at the end.
investment.real_net_payout_description: The final value adjusted for inflation — what it would buy at today's prices. This is the number that tells you whether you actually got richer.
investment.gross_value_description: What the position is worth on the last day, before the sell fee and taxes are taken off.
investment.disclaimer: Estimates only, based on a constant average return. Real markets fluctuate, and this is not financial advice.
